profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Camera Control at NVIDIA
profile.summary: Ten plus years of imaging engineering experience with a strong background in image processing, camera ISP, image quality evaluation and quality assurance for surveillance, automotive, and mobile ISP. Specialist in HDR imaging. Strong team player with excellent analytical, verbal and written communication skills. Easily develops customer relationships.

positions.title: Senior Imaging Architect
positions.description:
Design, review and validate image processing pipelines for various applications.
Technical lead for calibration, system modeling, optimization and quality review.
CMOS sensor & optical characterization.
Manage projects and work closely with customers through all stages of project deliverables.
Act as technical liaison between engineering and sales and marketing teams.
Support pre-sales activities; customer requirements definitions; SOW writing.
Promote technologies speaking at industry events.

positions.title: Technical Specialist - Imaging
positions.description:
Serve as technical sales and marketing resource for imaging technologies. Perform product demonstrations and assist pre sales activities. Provide information on system capabilities and customer requirements extraction. Provide training and technical guidance to ARM engineers in resolving customer issues, both domestically and internationally. Plan, develop, and man trade show booths. Worked closely with internal research group in developing new system algorithms for display, HDR ISP and calibration tools. 

•	Resolved difficult technical issues for major clients, keeping them as customers.

positions.title: Senior Field Application Engineer
positions.description:
Technical lead of field applications team in the US and China supporting ISP and display imaging technologies. Managed customer relationships. Debugged customer hardware and software issues and developed workarounds. Analyzed images to determine root cause of poor image quality, noise, artifacts and other issues. Analysis of field issues led to insights instrumental for development of next generation products. Trained customers in ISP Image Quality tuning, evaluation and camera calibration; developed training courses and delivered to customers and internal teams. Assisted customers in developing imaging labs from scratch. Performed final QA inspection prior to product demonstrations and product release. 

•	Assisted in product sales success and acceptance by Tier 1 companies.
•	Tuned and calibrated Apical technology on flagship consumer smartphones and security cameras.
•	Go-to specialist for a wide variety of imaging issues.

positions.title: Senior Imaging Researcher
positions.description: Developed algorithms for auto white balance (AWB), demosaic, and dynamic range compression for HDR ISP. Developed ISP calibration methodologies and software including RAW image analysis and Image Quality optimization. Tuned ISP an lead Image Quality evaluation for internal review, pre sales demonstrations and customer products. Ensured maximum image quality, reducing customer time to market. Trained customer imaging teams in ISP tuning methodology. Debugged a wide variety of customer imaging issues, implemented workarounds and fixes on site with customers with tight deadlines. Assisted international clients in becoming the leading security camera companies in their countries by optimally using Apical's imaging technologies. Established Apical's imaging lab.
